caption: Prompt Turn
description: An ACP prompt turn observed from a native source: the user's prompt submission, the turn's start, or the turn's completion with run-scope reported usage, cost, stop reason and run-scope permission decisions.
name: prompt_turn

1.caption: Prompt submitted
1.description: A user prompt record was observed.

2.caption: Turn completed
2.description: A record reporting the turn's completion was observed.

3.caption: Turn started
3.description: A record reporting that the turn started was observed.

cli_agent.description: The CLI agent is stored once per run in run.json shared.cli_agent (0.2.0); it is present on an event only in a self-contained export.

assembly.description: Present in a finally assembled file: this event's assembly role and evidence.

data.description: The native record exactly as reported, when retained on the event.

duration.description: The source-reported elapsed execution time in integral milliseconds. No start/end timestamps or aggregation window are inferred. Exact non-integral durations use execution_metrics in their native unit.
